hypotheses.justification: This follows from hd. The image of d is a unit, so hd makes (p : ZMod (M / p)) a unit. By ZMod.isUnit_prime_iff_not_dvd, p ∤ M / p. Nat.dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hpM then gives ¬ p² ∣ M. Derive hpM2 this way and retain the original proof. These lemmas also handle modulus 1 or 0.

Neither ζ nor hζ occurs in the conclusion or the remaining hypotheses. Since Qb is algebraically closed of characteristic zero and p is prime, HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_isPrimitiveRoot supplies a primitive pth root in Qb. Convert it to a unit using IsPrimitiveRoot.isUnit and IsPrimitiveRoot.isUnit_unit, then run the original proof with this chosen root instead. Primality ensures p ≠ 0, so there is no exceptional zero-order case; the chosen unit is nonzero as required by the coefficient argument.
